review: Companion modifiers and catalogue through first natural-limb variants inventoried. Remaining B43 variants, modifiers, sensory secrecy and executable contracts pending.

entries.acceptance: Build supernatural companion from actual ancestry, raising intelligence to at least six if initially five or less. Appearance may gate physical presence or special capabilities; select mode before play. Price actual component traits.

Granted powers require special companion capability modifier and separately purchased abilities with -40% linked-access restriction. Disable grants on failed appearance, companion stun/unconsciousness/death or failed link conditions. Do not erase purchase or double-charge granted resources.

Unconditional-service modifier is +0% for intelligence zero or programmed servility, otherwise +50%. It removes ordinary departure for mistreatment but retains authored breakdown risks and supervision requirements.
Companion exceptional-influence/granted-power modifier +50% applies to out-of-proportion access, not merely exotic traits already priced in companion value.

Summonable companion +100% replaces adventure appearance with concentrate plus appearance check. Success places companion nearby through authored legal placement; failure locks retry for one full day. Free dismissal requires physical presence; preserve identity rather than spawning duplicates.

Sympathetic condition link transfers stun, unconsciousness, mind control and specified effects between partners. Death reducing other to zero health is -25%, killing other -50%; one-way owner-to-companion versions -5%/-10%. Propagation must avoid loops and duplicate consequences.
Coerced companion -50% permits authored rebellion when compliance is worse than consequences of refusal. Departure loses invested value; this is separate from ordinary replacement entitlement.

Accelerated subjective time costs100 per level, granting one extra maneuver per level on existing turn without earlier initiative. Preserve full-turn restrictions. Feint or social influence requiring others’ reactions consumes entire turn despite extra maneuvers.

Accelerated time permits an additional sense or authored intelligence-based planning/recall check without action penalty. Define eligible information and actual check instead of unlimited extra actions.

Alternate registered identity costs five legal or fifteen illegal per identity. Legal version needs at least ten points in approved authority/access traits. Documents/biometrics do not create wealth; financial accounts require actual funds.

Unnamed identification initially selects equally among identities. Continued investigation can reveal others; government identification destroys alternate identities under source rule. Illegal identity consequences depend on jurisdiction; record evidence and discovery state.
Five-point equal-handedness removes off-hand -4 dexterity penalty but grants no extra action. Unspecified one-arm accident defaults left; deliberate/random locations still use their actual rules.

Ten-point water adaptation removes underwater work skill penalties and permits swimming at full basic movement, but supplies no breathing exemption. Water-only locomotion is a different negative trait.

Five-point animal insight uses hidden intelligence check on meeting animal, reporting emotion and supernatural control awareness. Enables ordinary influence skills on animals; author must define truthful, false or absent impressions according to actual check rules.

Extra arm dexterity costs twelve per level for one arm, sixteen for two; three-plus requires overall dexterity purchase. Applies only arm tasks, never combat skills or basic speed; multi-hand tasks use lowest participating arm dexterity. Inherit applicable manipulation limitation.

Extra arm strength costs three/five/eight per level for one/two/three arms; four-plus requires overall strength. Affects arm lifting/throwing/attacks, not health/global lift; multi-arm tasks use average participating strength with rounding resolved. Inherit eligible size/manipulation discounts.

Restraint attack costs two per level: range100, accuracy3, rate1, recoil1, no half-range/shot limit. Hit roots target, forbids move/posture/facing and gives dexterity-4; restraint strength equals level, later layers add one each.

Each one-second escape compares target strength or escape skill with restraint strength. Failed attempt costs one fatigue and permits retry. Damaging restraint: innate attack auto-hits, other victim attacks -4, external attacks ordinary but risk victim on miss.

Restraint armor floor(level/3); each damage reduces strength one, zero frees victim. Resolve whether armor follows original level or altered layered strength explicitly; preserve shared restraint identity.

Engulfing +60% pins and prevents speech/limb movement; permits purely mental abilities, innate attacks on restraint and strength-only escape. Failed escape retries every ten seconds; raw17/18 prevents further self-escape. Persist deadline and condition.
Damage vulnerability restriction costs +30% for one of burning/corrosion/crushing/cutting, +20% two, +10% three. Validate chosen set and reject other damage without consuming target durability.
Sticky +20% uses persistence only on people touching original target. Track contact events and propagation boundaries without unlimited recursive spread.
Unbreakable +40% prohibits damage destruction but leaves escape contest. Do not model with arbitrarily high armor.
Environmental requirement -20% through -40% depends on approved actual prerequisite. One-layer-only -10% prevents strengthening with repeated hits. Validate both before rolling/payment.

Divine insight costs ten, needs at least hour of approved ritual, hidden intelligence check and ten fatigue at completion; followers react +1. Twenty-point tier adds five to insight check and reaction becomes +2. Failure to uphold actual obligations can remove trait under authored decision.

Ten-point blessing chooses strength/dexterity/health or approved alternate score at purchase. Once per session add1d for3d seconds; on expiry apply actual accumulated losses/thresholds, not heal or reset injury. Session identity and temporary contribution must persist.
Five-point branch-swinging gives climbing+2 and half-basic-movement travel through suitable supports. Validate support path and free limbs; do not grant unrestricted flight.

Breath reserve costs two per level and doubles holding duration per level. Not available to ordinary humans; can combine with breathing-control skill when eligible. Integrate actual activity/oxygen ledger.

Ten-point fall grace automatically subtracts five fall yards as acrobatic success, without another acrobatics roll; dexterity success additionally halves damage. Requires unbound limbs and freedom to twist.

Adaptive coloration costs five per level: visual stealth+2 per level still, +1 moving. Clothing reduces to+1 still/zero moving unless appropriately camouflaged. Select one affected visual/scanning sense; no automatic benefit against unrelated senses or darkness.
Each additional affected sense +20%. Always-active limitation -10% also gives stranger reaction -1; preserve inability to toggle.

Ten-point spirit channel requires minute concentration then will, +2 for trance capability. While entranced actor lacks surrounding awareness; nearby spirit can communicate through body under author control, without truth guarantee. Possessing spirit counts as touching, but host resists at +5.

Social presence costs five per level: +1 reaction per level for actively interacting sapient audience, influence+1 and specified divination/leadership/begging/public-speaking skills+1. Author may exclude very alien audiences; avoid applying both trait and already-adjusted skill bonus twice.

Hospitality access ranges one through ten points with group scope. Search takes1d-1 hours and succeeds on14 or less; incidental suitable crowd contact6 or less. Group reactions+3 and basic lodging/aid, with reciprocal home obligations. Repeated refusal can lose trait through authored consequences.

Remote viewpoint costs fifty, moves all ranged senses to one location/facing within ten yards. Minute concentration plus intelligence; unseen destination requires distance/direction and -5. Double range costs two fatigue per minute. Body loses those senses, but ability ranges remain body-originated.

Success establishes viewpoint with darkness ignored but solid obstacles respected; failure by one sends senses to authored alternate point, greater failure does nothing, critical disables ability1d hours. Keep true viewpoint private where appropriate.

Returning, relocating or rotating senses requires one-second concentration plus intelligence. Attached viewpoint follows moving object automatically. Only one shared viewpoint, not split senses; maintain owned duration/payment and carrier identity.

Hearing-only -30%, smell-only -60%, vision-only -10%, psychic-sensory membership -10%, visible manifestation -10%. Selected sense subset changes displaced senses; modifier names alone do not implement visibility or interference.

Natural hand/foot weapons apply to all such limbs with no partial-limb discount. Initial variants: blunt3 points adds one per punch/kick die; hoof3 adds one per kick die and foot armor+1; sharp5 converts punch/kick to cutting. Remaining variants continue B43 before catalogue completeness.
